name: Pokémon Let's Go, Pikachu! & Eevee!
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. All teams are the first (story) battles from Bulbapedia's Let's Go party data (game = PE), not the post-game rematches; Let's Go teams/levels differ from Generation I. Giovanni's entry is his Viridian Gym battle (his third encounter), not the earlier Team Rocket Hideout or Silph Co. fights. Champion Trace's team differs by version only in the final slot: recorded here is the Let's Go, Pikachu! variant with Jolteon (Lv 57); in Let's Go, Eevee! that slot is Raichu (Lv 57) and the rest of the team is identical. Trace Mega Evolves his Pidgeot; it is recorded as plain 'pidgeot' because the boss schema has no form field. Agatha legitimately fields two Gengar (Lv 53 and Lv 54). Moves, abilities and items are intentionally left blank.
